resources.string: Recording while this screen is open and your phone is charging.
Recorded while this screen was open. Gaps mean it was closed.
Power and current were recorded from %1$s on, while this screen was open. Earlier points come from battery history, which has level, temperature and voltage only.
Drawn from battery history. Charging in the background records only level, temperature and voltage, so power and current are not shown.
No moderate-or-higher device thermal status was reported in the recorded readings.
Recorded readings show moderate-or-higher device thermal status between %1$s and %2$s battery.
A recorded reading shows moderate-or-higher device thermal status at %1$s battery.
Plug in your phone with this screen open to record a live curve of power, current, voltage and temperature. Charges in the last day also show up here from battery history.
Kernel battery data is unavailable. Start Shizuku, then refresh.
This kernel does not report it.
Needs a clean charge of 40% or more first.
Measured capacity comes from the charge counter during long charges, so it can differ from the kernel figure.
Full capacity as a share of design capacity
Wear needs at least two health records. One is saved after each long charge, so check back after a few.
No time above %1$s. Checked %2$s of the charge.
%1$s above %2$s (peak %3$s). Charging warm wears a battery faster. Checked %4$s of the charge.
No temperature readings for this charge.
No time at or above %1$s. Checked %2$s of the charge.
%1$s at or above %2$s (peak %3$s). Sitting at high voltage wears a battery faster. Checked %4$s of the charge.
No voltage readings for this charge.
Based on battery history, which logs about one point per percent, so brief peaks can be missed.
Rules of thumb: heat means above %1$s, high voltage means %2$s or more. They are guides, not a verdict on your battery.
Heat and voltage findings appear once a charge has been recorded.
Grant Shizuku access from Cockpit, then charge your phone with this screen open. Your health record starts after the first long charge.
Something went wrong while reading. Try again in a moment.
Could not refresh. Showing the last data.
